about: The hero types of layout v4 (references/layout-v4.md section 3), each built in this folder as hero-<id>.html and shot at 1440x900, 1024x768, 820x1180 and 390x844. A builder deals one at random by the brief's type and the material it really has: node <skill>/assets/layout/deal.mjs --type <software|product|service> --has <photo,ui,film,object,ground>. A place with a matching photograph uses hero-place.html in one of five forms. Without one it uses the statement hero. A hero takes the height of its copy from 72svh to 100svh. A large picture or product window fills the first screen. Where the next section begins in view, keep its heading and action whole. Its blocks stand on the container's two lines (x 80 and 1360 at 1440, 24 and 366 at 390) or run edge to edge; never out to one viewport edge only. The foot form allows a bottom scrim up to 35% over the lowest 40%. Numbers are px, measured on the demos (check.mjs prints them): [1440x900, 390x844]. h1 sizes in 'size' are before --ly-scale; the measured ones in at1440/at390 are after the demo's scale. A dealt product window with hero--peek can extend below the fold with at least 420px visible at 1440x900.

fields.types: Eligible page types and weights. A game uses the gaming weights. A place with pictures takes the place hero. A product without a picture takes split with its own built view.
fields.needs: Material the hero uses. A vertical bar means either. photo is a photograph of the subject, art its artwork, ui its screen, film actual footage, object a cut-out or render, setting a game world to illustrate, and ground a flat field.
fields.h1: the layout.css token, its size at 1440 and 390 before --ly-scale, the leading, the most lines at each width and the longest headline that fits
fields.grid: where each block stands on the 12 columns at 1440 (from 1024 up); below 1024 everything stacks in the order given
fields.at1440: measured on the demo at 1440x900 (the fixed header 72 over the hero's top, the hero exactly 900, words from y 120, content ending by y 836, container x 80 to 1360)
fields.at390: measured on the demo at 390x844 (header 56, the hero exactly 844, words from y 96, content ending by y 820, container x 24 to 366)
fields.moment: the hero's own small motion (layout.js) after the entrance every hero makes once on load (data-enter, motion.md), how it rests, and what reduced motion and a phone show; 'none' means nothing more than that entrance. The page's dealt moments are apart (moments.mjs pick). On kind other (site-kind other) and on a place the hero's own loops rest (the page's moments and scene are dealt by fit, moments.mjs): the collage sets and the steps rest on their first or finished picture (pointer-driven letters and hover stay)
fields.moments: assets/moments/index.json ids that may be dealt onto this hero (one at most; moments.mjs pick --fits hero decides), as { id, only? }: only "tech" means software, AI and gaming briefs only
fields.grounds: assets/backgrounds/index.json ids the hero may stand on, as { id, only?, dark? }: only "tech" for software, AI and gaming briefs only; dark true for a dark page only
fields.effects: assets/effects ids the hero's visual may carry, as { id, as? }: every effect is for tech, software, AI and gaming briefs only, never a place or a local business; 'as' says where it goes when that is not the visual itself
fields.mistakes: what makes it fail the house's look
fields.avoid: the material that rules it out: with it in --has the hero is never dealt (word and statement are for briefs without a strong photograph or a film; with one, it leads)

heroes.name: Editorial type with pictures in the line
heroes.from: award-site studios and agencies (pictures set inside the headline), Pentagram, Linear's manifesto pages, architecture practices
heroes.job: RETIRED, never dealt: it set photographs inside the headline as pills, which breaks the house rule "no picture inside a headline" (CONTEXT.md). The headline is the picture: three lines of big left-aligned type across the whole container with one or two photographs set in the line as pills, whole on the first frame. The lead and the buttons dock to the foot under a hairline. For studios, practices, agencies, makers and shops with two or three strong details (never a place: it has hero-place).
